label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is encodeForHTML(sql) where sql contains user input from request headers concatenated directly into SQL string at line 59; HTML encoding at response does not mitigate SQL injection vulnerability. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is sql = "SELECT..." + bar + "'" where bar = param from user-controlled headers; no parameterization or escaping applied. Both alerts demonstrate attacker-controlled data reaching dangerous sinks.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request headers and URL-decoded into param variable
param passed to doSomething which returns it as bar, then bar concatenated directly into SQL string without sanitization
XSS sink: encodeForHTML(sql) called but sql already contains unescaped user input enabling SQL injection
